name: Kasumi Reina
source: A very friendly and kind woman. She is the wife the of the protagonist boss. Which seems very strange considering how rude and mean her husband is compared to her. Her husband has become more distance and less caring than when the first started dating with him being so busy at work. After getting a massage from protagonist despite feeling a little guilty about she still wants to become a repeat customer.
